question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The situation in which a disease is spread by touching someone or something
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e.** 'Contagion'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contagion : (स्‍पर्श या संपर्क से फैलने वाला रोग, रोग का संक्रमण****)** - The situation in which a disease is spread by touching someone or something.

 
 
• **Example: **The rapid **contagion** of the Coronavirus forced the city into lockdown.
 
 

*Therefore, the correct answer is **'**Contagion'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Fatal : (घातक) **- Causing death.

 
 
• **Example: **The car accident was fatal, sadly leaving no survivors.
 
 
 
• **Infected : (संक्रमित) **- Having the presence of a pathogen that causes disease.
 
 
• **Example:** The wound got infected because it was not cleaned and bandaged properly.
 
 
 
• **Malleable : **(लचीला) - Able to be hammered or pressed into shape without breaking or cracking.
 
 
• **Example:** Gold is a malleable metal, that’s why it's often used in jewellery.
 
 

33:T9c9,

The correct answer is **option (2).**
